description.name: description
description.default: 'Whether you''re a total newbie or a seasoned marathoner, we''re your running squad! 🏃‍♂️ Join undegrads, grad students, profs, and Stanford presidents for runs whenever you can make it. No pressure, just good vibes and great company. Trust us, there''s always someone at your pace ready to hit the trails! Come run with us and see what the hype is all about. 🌲'

description.name: description
description.default: 'Ran in high school? We compete in cross country, track, and road races across the Bay Area and beyond. We have a great time and are always looking for new members.'

coach_bio.name: coach_bio
coach_bio.default: 'A Palo Alto native (born in Stanford Hospital), Ernie Lee ran competitively for Gunn High School and Princeton University. After graduating with a degree in physics, Ernie completed graduate studies at Stanford in the applied physics department. It was then that he began coaching at his former high school. He coached both cross country and track and field at Gunn High School for 18 years. Ernie currently works for a nanomaterials company and still races as a member of the HOKA Aggies Running Club.'
